Robert's Scrolls

To the Rescue

Robert MegerdichianOctober 19, 2026Last Updated: October 19, 2026
0 3 minutes read
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread
Felix was my classmate from sixth through eighth and throughout high school in Cambridge. After seven years together, I regret to say that no student really liked Felix. Every day, he wore black pants and a light-colored business shirt. He kept to himself, never socialized or made friends. I don’t think any schoolmate ever had a real conversation with him. Frankly, we considered him weird. Who were we to say?  We all had qualified for placement in the city’s Academically Talented program
